source_text.body:
Give an agent its own email to finish sign-ups
The poster gave Muse its own email address so it can complete account sign-ups and handle verification emails without stalling.
·
Oct 29, 2026
Done with
MM
Meta Muse
What they did
The poster built BotsInbox after Muse workflows kept stalling at email verification. A Muse can create its own account with one API call, make inboxes at botsinbox.com, read mail through a REST API or hosted MCP server, and use an automatically parsed extracted_code field to continue sign-ups without a person copying codes from Gmail; the post also says one separate Muse user completed signup and first email with zero human help.
How it went
In beta, the poster says BotsInbox verified BotsInbox’s own Instagram and TikTok accounts using codes delivered to and extracted from its inboxes. A commenter who tested the signup said the flow worked and the REDDIT-META code gave 10 inboxes and 90-day retention, but warned the API key was only shown once and recovery or rotation was not apparent.
Worth knowing
Free receiving is unlimited, but sending is paid; the free plan in the post is 5 inboxes with 30-day retention, or 10 inboxes and 90 days with the Reddit code while the 100 invites last.
Try it yourself
with
Meta Muse
Copy prompt
I need to sign up for [service or website] using the dedicated email address [agent email address]. Fill out the sign-up form, then open that inbox, find the verification email, and complete confirmation. Pause and show me the details before submitting anything that involves payment or personal information, and stop once the account is verified and I can log in.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/MetaAI/comments/1xl2jiu/i_gave_my_muse_its_own_email_address_so_it_could
